title: upload and verify medical document
description: Test the /api/upload endpoint to ensure it correctly accepts a medical document, generates a SHA-256 hash, runs ML fraud detection, encrypts the file, uploads it to IPFS, and returns the expected response including docHash, ipfsCid, riskAnalysis, and metadata.

title: verify document integrity against expected hash
description: Test the /api/verify endpoint to verify that uploading a document and providing an expected hash returns the correct validation result indicating whether the document matches the expected hash.

title: download encrypted document from ipfs
description: Test the /api/download/{cid} endpoint to ensure it correctly downloads the encrypted document bytes from IPFS when provided a valid CID, and handles errors for missing or invalid CIDs.

title: decrypt and view document from ipfs
description: Test the /api/decrypt-view endpoint to verify that it fetches the encrypted document from IPFS using the provided CID and decrypts it correctly using the provided AES-256-CBC key, returning the decrypted document bytes in the appropriate format.

title: backend health check
description: Test the /api/health endpoint to confirm it returns the backend service health status, version, uptime, environment, and timestamp correctly.

title: initiate google oauth login
description: Test the /api/auth/google endpoint to verify it redirects the user to Google OAuth login page with a 302 status code.

title: handle google oauth callback and issue jwt
description: Test the /api/auth/google/callback endpoint to ensure it handles the OAuth callback correctly, issues a JWT token, and redirects to the frontend with a 302 status code.

title: verify google id token and issue jwt
description: Test the /api/auth/google/verify endpoint to verify that providing a valid Google ID token returns a signed JWT and user info, and invalid or missing tokens return appropriate error responses.

title: get current authenticated user
description: Test the /api/auth/user endpoint to ensure it returns the authenticated user's information when provided a valid JWT, and returns 401 Unauthorized when no or invalid JWT is provided.

title: logout user and clear session
description: Test the /api/auth/logout endpoint to verify it clears the authentication cookie or token and returns a success message confirming logout.
